1_B_INTEREST_RATE.rationale: Strongest mean regime differential across both horizons and representations

primary_regime_selection.justification: Strongest mean regime differential (0.021479) across all regime families in Phase 36-R

primary_horizon_selection.justification: H-10 shows consistent regime differentials across both binary and continuous representations. H-20 shows larger peak differential but less consistency.

primary_model_selection.justification: Same model that produced valid exploratory evidence. No model comparison performed.
